item.title: Retired county Treasurer-Tax Collector Dan McAllister dead at 74
item.description: "This is a sad day at the Treasurer-Tax Collector's office, and for San Diego," said San Diego County Treasurer-Tax Collector Larry Cohen.

item.title: Participants offer solutions at conference on homelessness, housing security
item.description: This year’s conference saw its attendance grow to 1,300 plus, nearly double the attendance of the previous year.

item.title: Avoid DMV lines and drive to Finest City Registration in Pacific Beach
item.description: Shaundra Flanigan’s family-owned and run auto registration business, which started in 2002 on Cass Street, is still going strong 23 years later at the crossroads of downtown Pacific Beach.

item.title: Dora Ristorante brings Southern Italian cuisine, charm to La Jolla
item.description: Their new eatery, which was designed by Bells + Whistles and named for Lota’s grandmother, is a large space: 3,800 square feet.

item.title: Local lawmakers demand answers after motorists stuck in series of I-5 shutdowns
item.description: Stretches of Interstate 5 have been temporarily shut down for planned or emergency closures at least once a month since September. And apparently San Diego County motorists are fed up and have made sure their elected representatives know it. item.title: Democrats give Adam Schiff a financial boost in his defense against Trump
item.description: Sen. Adam Schiff’s colleagues in Congress are helping out his legal defense against a Trump administration investigation in a big way.

item.title: University City man sentenced to 12 years for seeking photos from teen online
item.description: Eric Jacob Layton, who also faces charges in San Diego related to multiple alleged underage victims, was sentenced Wednesday.

item.title: Historic county building lit in blue and white to honor Sydney victims
item.description: The historic County Administration Center will be illuminated in remembrance of the victims of the mass shooting in Sydney, Australia.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV appoints San Diego auxiliary bishop to lead Monterey diocese
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has appointed San Diego Auxiliary Bishop Ramón Bejarano as the next bishop of the Diocese of Monterey, the Vatican announced Tuesday.

item.title: Authorities ID 14-year-old struck, killed by SUV on foggy Mira Mesa Street
item.description: Authorities Wednesday publicly identified a teenage boy who was fatally struck by an SUV last weekend on a fog-shrouded Mira Mesa street.
